variables.name: App
variables.input:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 90d
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown")
| summarize count(), by: { appName }
| fields appName
| append [ data record(appName = "All") ]
| fieldsAdd sortKey = if(appName == "All", then: 0, else: 1)
| sort sortKey asc, appName asc
| fields appName

variables.name: Feature
variables.input:
fetch bizevents, from: now() - 90d
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| summarize count(), by: { feedbackType }
| fields feedbackType
| append [ data record(feedbackType = "All") ]
| fieldsAdd sortKey = if(feedbackType == "All", then: 0, else: 1)
| sort sortKey asc, feedbackType asc
| fields feedbackType

1.content:
# In-product feedback
Every entry is a `feedback-form-submit` business event, sent from your app with the RUM JavaScript. Use **App** and **Feature** to filter, and **Replay** to watch what the user did before giving feedback.

2.content: ##### [🔮 Summarize the feedback for my current filters with Dynatrace Assist](/ui/intent/dynatrace.davis.copilot/ask-question#%7B%22prompt%22%3A%20%22Summarize%20this%20in-product%20user%20feedback%20for%20a%20product%20management%20audience.%20Executive%20summary%3A%202-3%20sentences.%20Top%20issues%3A%20bullet%20list%20of%20the%20most%20common%20pain%20points.%20Positive%20feedback%3A%20what%20works%20well.%20Recommendations%3A%20prioritized%20next%20steps%20for%20the%20product%20team.%20Notable%20patterns%20by%20app%2C%20version%2C%20feature%2C%20device%20or%20country.%20Raw%20data%20highlights%3A%20quote%20entries%20that%20are%20particularly%20insightful.%20Use%20the%20following%20DQL%20query%20verbatim%20to%20retrieve%20the%20data%2C%20do%20not%20change%20filters%20or%20timeframe%3A%20fetch%20bizevents%2C%20from%3A%20%5C%22%24dt_timeframe_from%5C%22%2C%20to%3A%20%5C%22%24dt_timeframe_to%5C%22%20%7C%20filter%20event.type%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22feedback-form-submit%5C%22%20%7C%20fieldsAdd%20appName%20%3D%20coalesce%28appName%2C%20%5C%22Unknown%5C%22%29%2C%20feedbackType%20%3D%20coalesce%28feedbackType%2C%20%5C%22general%5C%22%29%20%7C%20filter%20%5C%22%24App%5C%22%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22All%5C%22%20or%20appName%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22%24App%5C%22%20%7C%20filter%20%5C%22%24Feature%5C%22%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22All%5C%22%20or%20feedbackType%20%3D%3D%20%5C%22%24Feature%5C%22%20%7C%20fields%20timestamp%2C%20appName%2C%20appVersion%2C%20feedbackType%2C%20thumbs%2C%20feedback%2C%20device.type%2C%20browser.name%2C%20geo.country.name%20%7C%20sort%20timestamp%20desc%20%7C%20limit%20500%22%2C%20%22execute%22%3A%20true%7D)

3.title: Feedback entries
3.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown"), feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| filter "$App" == "All" or appName == "$App"
| filter "$Feature" == "All" or feedbackType == "$Feature"
| summarize entries = count()

4.title: Thumbs-up rate (%)
4.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown"), feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| filter "$App" == "All" or appName == "$App"
| filter "$Feature" == "All" or feedbackType == "$Feature"
| summarize up = countIf(thumbs == "up"), down = countIf(thumbs == "down")
| fieldsAdd rate = if(up + down > 0, then: round(100.0 * up / (up + down), decimals: 1), else: 0.0)
| fields rate

5.title: Feedback over time
5.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown"), feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| filter "$App" == "All" or appName == "$App"
| filter "$Feature" == "All" or feedbackType == "$Feature"
| fieldsAdd rating = coalesce(thumbs, "comment only")
| makeTimeseries entries = count(), by: { rating }, interval: 1d

6.title: Feedback by app
6.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown"), feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| filter "$App" == "All" or appName == "$App"
| filter "$Feature" == "All" or feedbackType == "$Feature"
| summarize entries = count(), by: { appName }
| sort entries desc

7.title: Feedback by feature
7.query:
fetch bizevents
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown"), feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| filter "$App" == "All" or appName == "$App"
| filter "$Feature" == "All" or feedbackType == "$Feature"
| summarize entries = count(), up = countIf(thumbs == "up"), down = countIf(thumbs == "down"), by: { appName, feedbackType }
| sort entries desc

8.title: Recent feedback
8.query:
fetch bizevents, from: $dt_timeframe_from, to: $dt_timeframe_to
| filter event.type == "feedback-form-submit"
| fieldsAdd appName = coalesce(appName, "Unknown"), feedbackType = coalesce(feedbackType, "general")
| filter "$App" == "All" or appName == "$App"
| filter "$Feature" == "All" or feedbackType == "$Feature"
| fieldsAdd sessionTs = formatTimestamp(timestamp, format: """yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z'""")
| fieldsAdd replay = if(isNotNull(dt.rum.session.id), then: concat("[▶ Replay](/ui/apps/dynatrace.users.sessions/session-viewer/", dt.rum.session.id, "/", sessionTs, ")"), else: "")
| fieldsAdd device = concat(coalesce(device.type, "?"), " · ", coalesce(os.name, "?"), " · ", coalesce(browser.name, "?"))
| fields timestamp, appName, appVersion, feedbackType, thumbs, feedback, replay, device, geo.country.name
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 1000
